# espalier_image_tag (Resource)

Another name for a local image (`container image tag`). Destroying it removes only that name, not the image. If the tag no longer points at its source, e.g. because the source was pulled again, it is tagged again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "espalier_image" "nginx" {
  name = "nginx:1.29-alpine"
}

# Containers refer to "web:current"; moving the tag swaps the image they
# are created from.
resource "espalier_image_tag" "web" {
  source = espalier_image.nginx.name
  target = "web:current"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source` (String) Reference of the image to tag, e.g. an `espalier_image`'s `name`. It must be present locally.
- `target` (String) The new reference, resolved like `espalier_image`'s `name`.

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) Digest the tag points at.
- `id` (String) Fully qualified reference of the tag, e.g. `docker.io/library/app:dev` for `app:dev`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Tags are imported as source,target, both as written in the configuration.
terraform import espalier_image_tag.web nginx:1.29-alpine,web:current
```
